context: Two cafe friends compare wellness and entertainment trends
purpose: Teach: ハリウッド/トレンド/タレント/エアコン/チャット/ビタミン/ギフト/バトル

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近のトレンド、サプリよりビタミンを食事で取るっていう流れ、いいね。
lines.en: I like this trend lately—getting vitamins from actual food instead of supplements.
lines.style: Light, conversational opening. Warm observation, like she's been thinking about this. Gentle cadence. Not performing, just noticing aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 分かる。ハリウッドのタレントもライフスタイル系の発信、増えてる。
lines.en: I know what you mean. Even Hollywood people are putting out more lifestyle stuff now.
lines.style: Genuine agreement. Leaning in slightly. Responsive tone—meeting her observation halfway. Easy and natural, not rushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの店、エアコン入れ替えたら客足ぐっと戻ってきたよ。
lines.en: We actually swapped out the AC unit, and customers came flooding back.
lines.style: Pleased, a little proud of the small victory. Matter-of-fact delivery—stating a fact she's genuinely happy about. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素晴らしい。グループチャットで来店報告、みんなしてた。
lines.en: That's wonderful. People were posting about coming in all over the group chat.
lines.style: Genuine warmth and appreciation. Appreciative of her success. Soft smile underneath the words. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今月、ギフトカードのキャンペーンやろうかな。
lines.en: I'm thinking about running a gift-card campaign this month.
lines.style: Thoughtful, mulling it over. Slight rise—sharing an idea she's been considering. Open-ended, inviting her take.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、SNSでバトルみたいに広告合戦すれば話題になるよ。
lines.en: That could work really well—if you make it competitive on socials, like a back-and-forth, people will definitely talk about it.
lines.style: Energized idea. Leaning forward slightly. Quick cadence but not rushed. Supportive and strategic. Like she's already picturing it.
